title: Oil supply and the majors
storyline: The oil majors and drillers, and the cartel meetings, inventory reports and chokepoint risks that set the price they sell into.

forces.name: OPEC+ quota decisions
forces.why: The cartel's monthly and ministerial meetings set how much crude reaches the market; src/domain/sector-coverage.ts files OPEC+ supply decisions under Energy.

forces.name: US inventories and the EIA outlook
forces.why: The EIA's weekly stock report and its monthly outlook are the official read on US supply and demand; sector-coverage.ts files both under Energy.

forces.name: Sanctions and chokepoints
forces.why: Gulf export routes and sanctions on Iran decide how much oil can physically move; the calendar dates the Saudi pipeline repair window and the UN sanctions-panel decisions.

forces.name: Gas and LNG policy
forces.why: Natural gas and LNG sit in the same sector and move the same companies; the calendar dates the G20 energy ministerial and the gas industry's main conference.
